verdict.rationale: Pylon exposes a REST API and webhooks for creating/reading/updating issues, accounts, contacts and task statuses, plus an MCP server letting AI tools read/update the same data (docs-31,34,35,36,37,4). However there is no evidence of a comprehensive, discoverable API spec (openapi/swagger probes all 404'd, pylon-probe-3) and no claim of full feature parity with UI-only capabilities like analytics dashboards, triggers builder, or chat-widget branding customization. missing for 10: explicit API parity claim/documentation, a published OpenAPI/swagger spec, coverage of UI-only features (dashboards, trigger templates, widget branding) via API.
